method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 24, compilation date 14 October 2024 (includes amendments to Act No. 38, 2024; register id C2024C00646), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00851.txt (retrieved 13 October 2026). Not deposited: Interactive Gambling (National Self-exclusion Register) Rules 2022; the Minister's determinations of conditions under ss 8AA, 8A, 8B, 8BA, 8BB, 15C(4A)(d); regulations under ss 8C, 8D(1A), 69A (their periods, procedures and conditions are inputs)

scope: From the seat of the gambler: which online gambling may lawfully be offered to me (s 4 gambling and wagering service; s 5 prohibited interactive gambling service with the s 5(3) exclusions for telephone betting (s 8AA), excluded wagering (s 8A: racing, pre-match sport, other events; not in-play, s 10B), excluded gaming (s 8B), place-based betting (s 8BA), excluded lottery (s 8D, not instant lotteries), trade promotions (s 8BB); s 8E regulated interactive gambling service; s 8 Australian-customer link; ss 15, 15AA lawful only with a State or Territory licence), that the offences fall on providers and never on me, s 69A as what it permits; Part 2B ss 15C, 15D (credit, credit cards, linked facilities, digital currency; the s 15D telephone exception as one input); Part 7B: s 61GB what the Register covers, ss 61JA-61JC registration (only I can apply; 3 months minimum, whole years, or life; residence statement; up to 5 consenting support persons; identification as an input), ss 61JF, 61JG duration and extension, s 61JH warning 14 days before expiry, s 61JK removal on my application (not in the first 3 months of a first registration; in writing; counselling statutory declaration; removed at the start of the eighth day unless withdrawn; life registrations included), ss 61JM, 61JN(5), s 61JD inducements, s 61KA no wagering services to me, ss 61LA-61LD marketing, ss 61MA-61MC accounts (no new account, closure and payout less deductible debts, no reopening). Not encoded: s 8C, s 10 exempt services, financial products and wholesale services; providers' ignorance and due-diligence defences; Part 2A; s 15E; Parts 3-6 (complaints, industry codes, ISPs); Part 7A advertising; Part 7B information, levy and review provisions; penalties.
seat: the gambler: the individual in Australia who bets, plays or buys tickets online, and who may exclude themselves through the National Self-exclusion Register (BetStop)
